subject: boot347 only; selected in preceding user-facing update before inspecting certificate-window outcomes
prior_knowledge: Prior read-only review inspected selected snippets and independently profiled alignment/eligibility. This is exploratory calibration, not held-out preregistration. No alternative boot will be substituted based on results.

rules.parse: Split all prefixes including embedded concatenations; keep physical line/column and source order, annotate fragmented lines. Do not sort away backwards events.
rules.clock: Use58oractualcount unique observed spectrum epoch/uptime anchors after first SNTP. Keep min/max/median offset; no chosen extra tolerance. Observed envelope is an empirical compatibility interval, not a proven timing or latency bound. SNTP provides an independent coarse reference only.
rules.segments: After first SNTP, cut when adjacent parsed uptime gap>30000ms or decrease>1000ms. Preserve/record smaller interleavings. Analyze ALL segments; choose longest by duration only for human-readable illustration. No observed gap does not prove completeness.
rules.csv_membership: Segment rows satisfy start_uptime/1000+max_observed_offset <= timestamp <= end_uptime/1000+min_observed_offset. This is conditional on empirical envelope, not certified timing. No interpolation across gaps.
rules.commands: Record all Sent ACTUATOR_CMD and all GEO_PERTURB; associate each GEO with first following sent command and Hue record within5seconds in same segment, preserving payload/line refs. All observed GEO events are included.
rules.command_rows: For each GEO, report last definitely-before and first definitely-after CSV row under empirical envelope, all matching PWM/CCT tuples within one nominal18second sampling interval, and any temporal ambiguity; do not call a compatible tuple a causal response.
diagnostics: GEN unchanged open(-3,8),min60,thirds of normalized mean spectra,nonzerovelocities,signedcos>0
rules.diagnostic_scope: Re-evaluate same numerical formulas on frozen segment row identities; these are new window diagnostics, not inherited per-log certificates, not current formal8localplan family, no reuse proof. Preserve N/A.
rules.excluded_C5: Historical source filters geo_kappa<100 before max<200; do not count it as a discriminating upper-bound check or silentlyfixit.
rules.validation: Independent reviewer checks parser/gaps, clock/sample associations, source hashes, numerical formulas and interpretations. No researchmoduleimport, hardware, theoremclaim, MTloop, causal inference or baseline advantage.

outputs: records/ clock anchors,gaps,all segments,GEO joins,window diagnostics
